## Creating Training Data

```{r}

# start - end is step_size*num_time_steps

# start - start is jump_size

trainingdata = add_observations_linear_tolerance(whaledf = data_nooverlap,
                                start_time = 0,
                                end_time = 7199.9,
                                num_time_steps = num_time_steps, 
                                numcep = 12,
                                step_size = 0.1,
                                jump_size = 0.1)

trainingdata %>% select(Time_Start, Time_End, Humpback)



table(trainingdata$Humpback)

trainingdata$Humpback <- relevel(trainingdata$Humpback, ref = 1)
#manual_annotations = read_excel(here::here("OrigData", "AW", "AWhb.xlsx"))
```



## Saving Predictions

```{r}
knn_tuning_cv = function(neighbors_param){
  tic("My Function Timer")

  training_cvs = vfold_cv(trainingdata, v = 5)
  
  # creating model
  knnmod_1 <- nearest_neighbor(
    neighbors = neighbors_param,
    weight_func = "rectangular",
    dist_power = 2
  ) %>%
    set_engine("kknn") %>%
    set_mode("classification")
  
  # creating recipe
  knnrecipe_1 <- recipe(Humpback ~ ., data = trainingdata) %>%
    step_rm(Time_Start, Time_End) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_dummy(all_factor_predictors())
  
  # creating workflow
  knnworkflow_1 <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(knnmod_1) %>%
    add_recipe(knnrecipe_1)
  
  # fitting model and saving cross-validated predictions
  knnfit_1 = knnworkflow_1 %>%
    fit_resamples(
      resamples = training_cvs,
      control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
    )
  
  predictions <- collect_predictions(knnfit_1)
  
  predictions = predictions %>%
    arrange(.row) %>%
    select(.row, .pred_class, Humpback)
  
  knncvpredictions = predictions %>%
    left_join(
      trainingdata %>%
        mutate(.row = row_number()) %>%
        select(.row, Time_Start, Time_End),
      by = ".row"
    ) %>%
    rename(preds = .pred_class)
  toc()
  return(list(
    neighbors_param = neighbors_param,
    knncvpredictions = knncvpredictions
  ))
}
```

## Not Saving Predictions

```{r}
knn_tuning_cv_multi_nopreds <- function(k_values) {
  tic("My Function Timer")
  
  training_cvs <- vfold_cv(trainingdata, v = 5)
  
  # custom metric set
  my_metrics <- metric_set(
    precision,
    recall,
    f_meas  # we'll control beta below
  )
  
  # model
  knnmod <- nearest_neighbor(
    neighbors = tune(),
    weight_func = "rectangular",
    dist_power = 2
  ) %>%
    set_engine("kknn") %>%
    set_mode("classification")
  
  # recipe
  knnrecipe <- recipe(Humpback ~ ., data = trainingdata) %>%
    step_rm(Time_Start, Time_End) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_dummy(all_factor_predictors())
  
  # workflow
  knnworkflow <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(knnmod) %>%
    add_recipe(knnrecipe)
  
  # grid
  k_grid <- tibble(neighbors = k_values)
  
  # tune
  knn_tuned <- knnworkflow %>%
    tune_grid(
      resamples = training_cvs,
      grid = k_grid,
      metrics = my_metrics,
      control = control_grid(save_pred = FALSE)
    )
  
  # collect metrics (default F1)
  metrics_f1 <- collect_metrics(knn_tuned)
  
  
  toc()
  
  return(list(
    k_values = k_values,
    tuning_results = knn_tuned,
    metrics_f1 = metrics_f1
  ))
}

```

```{r}
results2 <- knn_tuning_cv_multi_nopreds(c(100))

metric_set = results2$metrics_f1 %>% select(neighbors, .metric, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = .metric,
    values_from = mean) %>% select(neighbors, recall, precision, f_meas) %>%
  rename(F1 = f_meas)# precision, recall, F1


metric_set %>% 
  mutate(
    F2 = ifelse(
    is.na(precision) | is.na(recall) | (recall + 4*precision) == 0,
    NA_real_,
    (5 * precision * recall)/(recall + 4*precision)
    )
    )


results2$metrics_f2   # F2 scores
```

```{r}


# i is a input of a dataframe (knncvpredictions) and number of neighbors

calc_metrics <- lapply(results, function(res) {
  neighbors <- res$neighbors_param
  predictionsdf <- res$knncvpredictions
  
  if (nrow(predictionsdf %>% filter(preds == 1)) == 0) {
    knncv_recall <- 0
    knncv_precision <- NA
    
  } else if (nrow(predictionsdf %>% filter(preds == 0)) == 0) {
    knncv_recall <- 1
    knncv_precision <- nrow(predictionsdf %>% filter(Humpback == 1)) /
      nrow(predictionsdf %>% filter(preds == 1))
    
  } else if (nrow(predictionsdf %>% filter(Humpback == 1)) == 0) {
    knncv_recall <- NA
    knncv_precision <- 0
    
  } else {
    knncv_recall <- predictionsdf %>%
      recall(truth = Humpback, estimate = preds, event_level = "second") %>%
      pull(.estimate)
    
    knncv_precision <- predictionsdf %>%
      precision(truth = Humpback, estimate = preds, event_level = "second") %>%
      pull(.estimate)
  }
  
  knncv_f1 <- (2 * knncv_recall * knncv_precision) / (knncv_recall + knncv_precision)
  knncv_f2 <- (5 * knncv_recall * knncv_precision) / (knncv_recall + 4 * knncv_precision)
  
  data.frame(
    neighbors_param = neighbors,
    Recall = knncv_recall,
    Precision = knncv_precision,
    F1 = knncv_f1,
    F2 = knncv_f2
  )
})

final_df <- do.call(rbind, calc_metrics)

final_df %>% data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(Time_Steps = num_time_steps, .before = 1)%>% arrange(desc(Recall))

sorted_df = final_df %>% data.frame() %>% arrange(desc(F2))

sorted_df
```



## PR Curve


```{r}
library(PRROC)
library(ggplot2)


sorted_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Recall, y = Precision, 
             group = agg_window_length,
             color = factor(agg_window_length))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue", "green", "yellow")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Precision-Recall Curve on Window Predictions",
    x = "Recall",
    y = "Precision",
    color = "Window Length"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}



# Example data
y_true <- c(1,0,1,1,0,0,1,0,1,0)
y_scores <- c(0.9,0.2,0.8,0.7,0.3,0.4,0.95,0.1,0.85,0.5)

# Separate scores
scores_pos <- y_scores[y_true == 1]
scores_neg <- y_scores[y_true == 0]

# Compute PR curve
pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = scores_pos,
               scores.class1 = scores_neg,
               curve = TRUE)

# Extract curve data
pr_df <- data.frame(
  recall = pr$curve[, 1],
  precision = pr$curve[, 2],
  threshold = pr$curve[, 3]
)

# Plot with ggplot
ggplot(pr_df, aes(x = recall, y = precision)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Precision-Recall Curve",
       x = "Recall",
       y = "Precision") +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
create_df <- function(n) {
  rows <- vector("list", n)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    rows[[i]] <- data.frame(
      id = i,
      value = i^2
    )
  }
  
  result <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  return(result)
}


create_df(5)
```


## Create Output For Raven Visualization


```{r}
knntestingoutput = knnwindowpredictions %>% 
  dplyr::select(Time_Start, Time_End, Humpback, prediction)




#creating dummy low and high frequencies for now

knntestingoutput = knntestingoutput %>% mutate(low = rep(0, times = nrow(knntestingoutput)),
                         high = rep(1000, times = nrow(knntestingoutput)))



knntestingoutput = knntestingoutput %>% filter(prediction == 1) %>% 
  rename("Begin Time (s)" = Time_Start, "End Time (s)" = Time_End, 
         "Low Freq (Hz)" = low, "High Freq (Hz)" = high) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("Begin Time (s)", "End Time (s)", 
                  "Low Freq (Hz)", "High Freq (Hz)"))



#create output 
write.table(knntestingoutput, "knnevalwindowpreds.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```
